security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data:

bundle.shortDescription: A pixel-art status pet for Claude Code.
bundle.longDescription: Clawd floats above your other windows and shows what Claude Code is doing through pose, colour, motion and a short label, so you do not have to switch back to the terminal to find out whether Claude is working, blocked, done, or dead.
